summary.title: Learn C# by Building a Simple RPG
summary.one_liner: A free, step-by-step course that teaches beginner C# by building a small text-based Role Playing Game called SuperAdventure.
keywords: save and load game data sql
how do i learn programming with a game
takeaways: Work through lessons that go from C# basics (classes, properties, functions) to a working RPG.
Learn to define classes, create objects, use inheritance, constructors and collections in C#.
Build a Windows Forms UI in Visual Studio Community Edition, then add features like trading, saving to SQL Server, and a console front-end.
Later lessons cover refactoring and bonus features such as a vendor system and a world map.
summary.summary: This is a free lesson index for learning C# by building SuperAdventure, a short and simple Role Playing Game. The lessons are numbered and progress from setting up Visual Studio and defining classes, through inheritance, constructors, collections, functions and random numbers, to a UI and gameplay mechanics. Later sections cover refactoring, a vendor with buying and selling, saving data with MS SQL Server, a console UI, and bug fixes. The author notes that readers who already know C# basics may prefer the newer C#/WPF RPG lessons.
